verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is an AML and KYC compliance platform covering screening, monitoring and case management, so asking about defenses against identity fraud during onboarding is a fair question. The evidence pack documents no liveness detection, deepfake or AI-generated-face detection, or camera-injection defenses. The capabilities shown are limited to sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening, risk scoring, transaction monitoring and case workflows.
